blocks.text: Welcome to GoCoaching.

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern access to and use of the GoCoaching website, application, and associated educational technology services operated by **GoCoaching Learning Solution LLP** ("GoCoaching", "Company", "we", "us", or "our").
By registering, accessing, or using the platform, users agree to comply with these Terms and applicable laws.
Where a minor student uses our services, the parent or lawful guardian is responsible for providing necessary authorization and overseeing the child's participation.
Additional agreements may apply to independent tutors, mentors, or specialized services.
GoCoaching operates an educational technology platform facilitating connections between parents, students, independent tutors, teachers, and other authorized educational service providers.
Our platform may provide:

items: Quizzes, notes, assessments, and test papers.

blocks.text: GoCoaching is not necessarily the direct provider of tutoring services arranged between parents and independent tutors.
Unless expressly stated otherwise, the tutoring engagement is entered into between the parent or eligible student and the selected independent tutor.
Tutors listed on GoCoaching operate as independent educational service providers.
Their relationship with GoCoaching is intended to be on a **principal-to-principal basis**, subject to the actual contractual arrangements and applicable law.
Registration on GoCoaching does not, by itself, establish:

items: An agency relationship authorizing the tutor to bind the Company.
A guarantee of employment or earnings.

blocks.text: Tutors remain responsible for their independent professional conduct, qualifications, representations, and lawful delivery of educational services.
GoCoaching may establish platform standards, onboarding requirements, reporting obligations, and safety rules without automatically creating an employment relationship.
The actual legal classification of any relationship will depend on its substance and applicable law, not merely this contractual description.
Users must provide accurate and current information when registering.
Adults may create accounts in accordance with platform requirements.
Accounts or educational profiles concerning minors must be created, authorized, or managed by their parent or lawful guardian as required by law and platform procedures.
Users must:

items: Use the platform for lawful purposes.
Update information when material changes occur.

blocks.text: GoCoaching may restrict or suspend accounts where reasonably necessary to address security risks, misconduct, fraud, or violations of applicable rules, subject to legal requirements.
GoCoaching provides tools intended to help parents and students discover educational service providers.
Tutor profiles may contain information concerning qualifications, experience, subject expertise, teaching format, availability, service locations, and relevant platform assessments.
Parents and eligible students make their own decisions concerning tutor selection.
Users are encouraged to assess the tutor's suitability, teaching style, schedule, price, and other relevant factors before confirming a booking.
Any platform verification or assessment label should be understood according to the specific checks actually completed.
GoCoaching does not guarantee that a particular tutor will produce a specific academic outcome.
Users may request or book tuition services through the available booking process.
Depending on the service, confirmation may require:

items: Selection of tuition format, schedule, or duration.
Acceptance of applicable terms or declarations.

blocks.text: A booking is considered confirmed according to the status and confirmation information displayed by the platform.
Users must review booking details carefully.
Availability and schedules may depend on the selected independent tutor.
Applicable tuition charges, platform fees, resource fees, taxes, and other relevant charges will be displayed before payment confirmation.
Payments may be collected through authorized third-party payment service providers.
Depending on the transaction structure, GoCoaching may facilitate collection and settlement of amounts payable to independent tutors.
The distribution of funds between GoCoaching and a tutor will be governed by the applicable tutor agreement and payment arrangement.
Platform commissions and settlement arrangements do not, by themselves, convert independent tutors into employees.
Users must not knowingly submit fraudulent payment information or engage in unauthorized transactions.
Any mandatory taxes or legally required disclosures will be handled in accordance with applicable law.
GoCoaching may provide attendance, session completion, and academic progress reporting tools.
Tutors may be required to submit timely and accurate records relating to:
These records support transparency between tutors, parents, and the platform.
**Tutor settlement may be subject to completion of required session and progress reporting, as specified in the applicable tutor agreement.**
Reporting requirements do not authorize the platform or any tutor to falsify attendance or student performance.
Disputed records may be reviewed through the applicable support process.
Education is influenced by several factors, including student participation, attendance, learning needs, prior knowledge, and tutor performance.
GoCoaching does not guarantee particular marks, examination results, admission outcomes, or academic improvements.
Independent tutors are responsible for providing the services they agree to deliver with reasonable skill, care, professionalism, and lawful conduct.
Nothing in these Terms removes consumer rights or remedies available under applicable law.
Student safety and dignity are important requirements of the GoCoaching platform.
Tutors must not:

items: Physically punish, assault, or beat students.
Engage in harassment, abuse, threats, or intimidation.
Use degrading, discriminatory, or humiliating teaching methods.
Engage in inappropriate physical or personal contact.
Request unnecessary personal or family information.
Intrude into unrelated areas of a student's home.
Share confidential parent or student information without authorization.
Record, photograph, or publish student content without appropriate authorization and consent.
Use the tutoring relationship for exploitation, coercion, or unlawful conduct.

blocks.text: Tutors must comply with applicable child-protection laws and platform safeguarding policies.
Parents and students may report suspected misconduct using available support or safeguarding channels.
GoCoaching may suspend access, investigate complaints, preserve relevant records, or refer serious allegations to competent authorities where appropriate and legally required.
Parents and eligible students are expected to:

items: Use authorized booking and payment channels.
Avoid abusive, discriminatory, fraudulent, or unlawful conduct.

blocks.text: For minor students, parents or lawful guardians remain responsible for appropriate supervision and necessary authorization.
For home tuition, parents should establish suitable and safe arrangements appropriate to the student's age and circumstances.
Users must respect the privacy of other platform participants.
Personal information obtained through GoCoaching may be used only for authorized educational, booking, communication, or related lawful purposes.
Tutors must not independently sell, distribute, or misuse student or parent contact information.
Parents and students must similarly respect tutors' confidential personal information.
The collection and handling of personal information by GoCoaching is described in our Privacy Policy:
https://gocoaching.in/privacy-policy
Certain educational meetings may use third-party video conferencing, authentication, or communication services, including Google services where configured.
Users may be required to comply with the applicable provider's terms and privacy policies.
Users must not access meetings without authorization, disclose private meeting information improperly, or record sessions without required permission.
Availability of external services may depend on the third-party provider.
GoCoaching may provide digital educational resources including quizzes, practice materials, notes, tests, and downloadable content.
Unless expressly stated otherwise, the relevant copyrights and intellectual property rights remain with GoCoaching or the applicable lawful rights holder.
Users receive only the license expressly granted for their purchased or authorized use.
Users must not unlawfully:
Any restrictions and access conditions will remain subject to applicable law.
Cancellation, rescheduling, refund eligibility, and payment settlement will be governed by the applicable policy communicated to the user before booking or purchase.
Relevant factors may include:

items: Whether a tutor accepted the booking.

blocks.text: The platform must display material cancellation and refund conditions clearly before a user commits to payment.
Nothing in these Terms limits a refund or remedy that must be provided under applicable law.
A separate, published Refund and Cancellation Policy may form part of these Terms.
GoCoaching may establish requirements for tutor registration, documentation, qualifications, assessment, and continued platform access.
Approval to use the platform does not constitute a guarantee of future bookings, income, or employment.

Where a tutor violates applicable policies, GoCoaching may take proportionate action, including requesting clarification, restricting bookings, temporarily suspending access, or terminating platform privileges, consistent with applicable contractual and legal requirements.
Users must not:

items: Create fraudulent accounts or false profiles.
Harass, abuse, or threaten other users.
Access accounts or information without authorization.
Attempt unauthorized access to platform infrastructure.
Engage in unlawful activity using the platform.

blocks.text: GoCoaching may take appropriate action to address suspected violations.
We aim to maintain reliable access to GoCoaching.
However, temporary interruptions may occur because of maintenance, network problems, third-party outages, security events, or other operational circumstances.
We may update platform functionality and design while respecting applicable commitments and legal obligations.
Material changes affecting purchased services or user rights will be addressed in accordance with applicable law.
GoCoaching provides a technology platform facilitating educational service arrangements.
Independent tutors remain responsible for their own actions, omissions, representations, and performance of independently provided tutoring services.
GoCoaching does not automatically assume responsibility for every act of an independent tutor solely because the tutor uses the platform.

However, nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including liability arising from GoCoaching's own misconduct, negligence, applicable statutory obligations, or other non-excludable responsibilities.
Any applicable limitation of liability must be interpreted subject to Indian law and users' mandatory legal rights.
Users may submit support requests and complaints concerning:
GoCoaching may request relevant information to investigate and respond to a complaint.
Sensitive safeguarding complaints will be handled with appropriate access restrictions and escalation procedures.
Users retain rights to pursue remedies before competent authorities and courts as provided by applicable law.
Users may request closure of their accounts through available platform procedures.
GoCoaching may restrict or terminate access where there is a legitimate basis, including serious policy violations, unlawful conduct, fraud, or security concerns.
Where appropriate, users will be informed of relevant account restrictions and any applicable review or grievance process.
Termination does not eliminate outstanding lawful obligations, valid payment liabilities, or record-retention requirements.
These Terms are governed by applicable laws of India.
Disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts and authorities determined under applicable law.
Nothing in these Terms restricts statutory consumer remedies or mandatory rights to approach competent legal forums.
We may revise these Terms to reflect changes in our services, business operations, policies, or legal obligations.
The updated Terms will be published on the website with a revised date.
Where required, users will receive notice or be asked to accept material changes.
For service questions, complaints, or legal communications, please contact:
